title: Middle-Overs Momentum: Where Chennai Super Kings Gains or Loses Run Rate
dek: Overs seven to fifteen decide more T20 matches than they get credit for. Where does Chennai Super Kings' run rate rise or stall in that stretch?
excerpt: Chennai Super Kings have scored slower than the league in the middle overs since 2024. The data shows why the quiet phase is where totals are really set.
author: CricField Editorial Desk
keyTakeaways: Chennai Super Kings' middle-overs run rate: {{ev:mid-team-e2}} since 2024, against a league figure of {{ev:mid-league-e2}}.
Sides that lost three or more wickets in overs seven to fifteen won {{ev:midw-l3}} of the time.

sections.heading: The Overs Nobody Remembers
body: Highlights packages favour the first six overs and the last five. The middle nine overs, between the fielding restrictions and the death, are where an innings either keeps its momentum or loses it.

For Chennai Super Kings the middle-overs run rate was {{ev:mid-team-e1}} between 2008 and 2023, with the league at {{ev:mid-league-e1}}. Since 2024 it has been {{ev:mid-team-e2}} against {{ev:mid-league-e2}}.
On this measure their strongest season was 2023, at {{ev:mid-x-best-v}}, and their weakest 2019, at {{ev:mid-x-worst-v}}.

sections.heading: Momentum and Wickets
body: The middle overs carry their own wicket penalty. Across every IPL innings with a result, sides that lost no wickets between overs seven and fifteen won {{ev:midw-l0}} of the time, while those losing three or more won {{ev:midw-l3}}.
CSK finished above the league's middle-overs rate in {{ev:mid-good-seasons}} of {{ev:mid-season-count}} seasons.

sections.heading: Who Drives the Middle
body: Since 2024 {{ev:midb-lead-name}} has faced the most middle-overs balls for CSK, {{ev:midb-lead-balls}} of them, striking at {{ev:midb-lead-sr}}.

The middle overs reward batters who can hit spin and rotate strike against defensive fields. The player table shows strike rate and dot-ball rate side by side, the two levers that decide whether the run rate climbs.

sections.heading: Consolidation Is Not Always a Mistake
body: A slow middle phase is sometimes deliberate: a side that lost early wickets may be rebuilding to give its finishers a platform. Comparing raw run rates mixes those rebuilding innings with innings that simply stalled.

sections.heading: CricField Verdict: Win the Quiet Overs
body: Chennai Super Kings have been slower than the league in the middle overs recently. The target for the phase should be a run rate at or above the league without giving up the wickets that make the death overs productive.
Selection should value middle-order batters on dot-ball rate against spin as much as on strike rate.
